text.en:
Section 2 of Batas Pambansa Blg. 12 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 2. The University shall have a maximum of six degree-granting courses and one graduate school and
such degree courses, post-graduate courses and special courses as the Board of Regents may deem necessary
to support national objectives in Mindanao."
